# Ecer.com

> > Ecer.com is a leading B2B marketplace connecting global buyers with China manufacturers, suppliers, and exporters through integrated sourcing, logistics, and digital marketing services.

Ecer.com operates as a comprehensive foreign trade platform serving international businesses seeking to source products from China. The platform combines supplier directories, video discovery, video conferencing, freight forwarding, website building tools, and SEM advertising into a unified ecosystem for B2B commerce.

## Key Topics

- B2B Marketplace
- China Suppliers
- Manufacturer Directory
- Export-Import
- International Logistics
- Freight Forwarding
- Video Procurement
- Buyer Services
- Supplier Services
- Independent Website Builder
- Google Ads
- Digital Marketing
- Trade Exhibitions
- Multilingual Support
- Secure Video Conferencing

## Core Marketplace

- [Ecer.com Homepage](https://www.ecer.com): Main B2B marketplace for sourcing China manufacturers, wholesalers, suppliers, exporters & factories
- [Products Directory](https://www.ecer.com/products.html): Product marketplace connecting global buyers with China suppliers and manufacturers for direct contact
- [About Ecer.com](https://www.ecer.com/static/about_en): Company information and mission for B2B foreign trade ecommerce platform

## Buyer & Seller Tools

- [Ecer Buyer Center](https://uc.ecer.com/buyer/index): Buyer portal login and account authentication for Ecer platform users
- [Buyer Center Home](https://uc.ecer.com/home/index): Buyer account management and user authentication portal
- [Ecer Meet - Video Conferencing](https://www.ecer.com/corp/meeting.html): Secure video conferencing platform for B2B supplier-buyer business meetings
- [Video Procurement Meetings](https://www.ecer.com/static/meeting): Video procurement meeting platform for connecting suppliers with high-quality overseas buyers

## Video & Events

- [Video Channels](https://www.ecer.com/videos.html): Video directory showcasing supplier products and company introductions for product discovery
- [Ecer Trade Expo](https://www.ecer.com/expo): Directory of global trade exhibitions and industry events for B2B networking

## Logistics & Freight Services

- [Ecer Freight Platform](https://scm-en.ecer.com): Professional international logistics service platform for sea freight, air freight, and rail freight forwarding with smart quote search
- [Cargo Manager](https://scm.ecer.com): International logistics platform specializing in freight forwarding services for global shipping

## Website Building & Digital Marketing

- [Ecer Website Builder](https://ecweb.ecer.com): Independent website builder SaaS platform helping suppliers directly connect with global buyers
- [Ecer Foreign Trade Website Builder](https://wang.ecer.com): Foreign trade website builder for independent B2B site construction and ecommerce stores
- [Ecer Smart Advertising](https://sem.ecer.com): SEM advertising platform specializing in Google Ads campaigns for foreign trade promotion
- [Ecer Digital Marketing Services](https://mao.ecer.com): Digital marketing and cross-border ecommerce export promotion services for suppliers
